# RL in Robotics - 240MAR45 (student companion site)

> Companion site for 240MAR45 Reinforcement Learning in Robotics (MSc in Automatic Control and Robotics, UPC Barcelona). RL is presented from a control engineering perspective: approximate dynamic programming under uncertainty about the dynamics. Full text of all pages: https://AndreuCecilia.github.io/rl-robotics/llms-full.txt - machine-readable index: https://AndreuCecilia.github.io/rl-robotics/static/contentIndex.json. This site is the concept knowledge base; slides, notes, exercises, and code are distributed via the official university course page.
